title.narrative: Basic Infrastructure for Inclusive Growth in the Northeastern Provinces Sector Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will (i) rehabilitate and upgrade about 265 kilometers of roads in the four northeastern provinces (NEPs); (ii) install 10 rural domestic water supply (RDWS) schemes; (iii) provide infrastructure support for agricultural and rural value chains (ARVC) in Lang Son; and (iv) strengthen provincial infrastructure asset management.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Agriculture and rural value chain infrastructure in Lang Son province improved Indicator: About 10 agriculture cooperatives screened as potential for award of competitive grants under provincial program(s), (at least 50% female membership). (2016 baseline is 0) Progress/Status: 10 cooperatives screened using loan proceeds. Further activities integrated into government programs separated from the project. Data Source: PPMS, QPR Actual value:

Output: Agriculture and rural value chain infrastructure in Lang Son province improved Indicator: About nine rural domestic water supply schemes comprising approximately a total of 250km of pipes laid (2016 baseline: 0) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: For attention. As of Jan 2026, all 9 water supply contracts awarded, with about 218km pipe laid, less than anticipated. DMF needs updating to reflect the actual length of pipe laid. One WS plant in Cao Bang and one in Lang Son not yet fully operational - LCD being extended to 30 June 2026 for completion. DMF target date to be adjusted. Data Source: 2a. PPMS, QPR

Output: Agriculture and rural value chain infrastructure in Lang Son province improved Indicator: Two agriculture enterprises screened as potential for award of competitive grants under provincial program(s), with at least 1 led by woman-leader (2016 baseline is 0) Progress/Status: Two enterprises screened using loan proceeds. Further activities integrated into government programs separated from the project. Data Source: PPMS, QPR Actual value:

Output: Indicator Indicator: About 13 training programs, one for each road subproject, provided to vulnerable road users on each of the road subprojects, of whom female users account for 50% of trainees (2016 baseline: 0 measures and training) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achieved. 19 traffic safety awareness training programs were conducted for 18 road subprojects to vulnerable road users with the participation of 2,129 people, of which 1,144 women account for 53.7% Data Source: PPMS

Output: Indicator Indicator: About 44 traffic calming measures provided to all road sections passing schools, markets, medical facilities, and administrative centers (2016 baseline: 0 measures) Achievement: 1 Progress/Status: Achieved. 60 calming measures provided to all road sections passing schools, markets, medical facilities, and administrative centers. Data Source: PPMS

Output: Agriculture and rural value chain infrastructure in Lang Son province improved Indicator: Strengthened management board of existing Star Anise and Cinnamon Association (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: ARVC consultant is mobilized in June 2021. Star Anise association was consolidated with project support. Support to associations for other commodities integrated in government programs separate from the project. Data Source: PPMS, QPR Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y

Output: Decentralized public asset management processes established Indicator: Asset planning systems producing maintenance management information, including budget needs and timelines, operational in each province (2016 baseline: 0) Achievement: N Progress/Status: Activities integrated in government program separate from project. Conventional public asset management system is used for meantime and will be assessed at project completion.. Data Source: PPMS, QPR Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Indicator Indicator: About 121 km of provincial and 144 km of district roads improved (2016 baseline: 0 km) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achieved. All civil work contracts awarded and about to complete in project provinces of total 285km (130 km of provincial roads and 155 km of district roads).
Data Source: PPMS Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: 0 Target year: 2025 Target value: 265 km Actual value: 0

Output: Indicator Indicator: Decentralized irrigation infrastructure asset planning systems producing management information on maintenance budget needs extended into Ha Giang, Bac Kan, and Cao Bang using the Asian Development Bank-supported Ministry of Finance model (2016 baseline: 0) Achievement: N Progress/Status: See above. Data Source: PPMS, QPR Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y Actual value: N

Output: Road network connectivity improved Indicator: Water supply asset management planning with supporting databases for business management reporting for the 9 rural domestic water supply schemes established (2016 baseline: 0) Achievement: N Progress/Status: See above. Data Source: PPMS, QPR Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2025 Target value: Y Actual value: N
Production, service delivery, and movement of goods and passengers sustainably increased

About 14 communes have year-round reliable access to clean water (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: For attention. LCD being extended to complete pending works: One water supply plant in Cao Bang and one in Lang Son.
Two water supply schemes were cancelled due to economic unfeasibility (one in Lang Son, and one in former Bac Kan). The number of communes may be less than 12 against 14 as in revised MTR DMF which will not impact on the overall project outcome. Data Source: PPMS, provincial people's committee annual reports Target value: 14 communes Actual value:

About 44 communities within 2 km of the developed transport network. (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Achieved. Data Source: PPMS, Government and public transport operator statistics, additional subproject feasibility reports. Target value: 44 communities Actual value:

10% average annual increase in movement of goods (ton-km) on improved roads. (2016 baseline: 16.9 ton-km) Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion. Data Source: PPMS, Government and public transport operator statistics, additional subproject feasibility reports. Baseline value: 16.9 ton-km

Asset management data to support O&M for provincially owned road and irrigation infrastructure integrated into annual provincial reports and development plans (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: For attention. Activities integrated in government program separate from project. Conventional system is used and will be assessed at project completion. Data Source: Provincial annual reports and socioeconomic development plans Base year: 2016 Baseline value: N

Average annual increase of 5% in passenger car units on improved roads. (2016 baseline: 468,612 PCUs) Progress/Status: To be assessed by project completion. Data Source: PPMS, Government and public transport operator statistics, additional subproject feasibility reports. Baseline value: 468,612 PCUs

Incremental increase in value chain margins by D15.00 million per ha for star anise in three communes (2016 baseline: D34.00 million per ha) Progress/Status: Assessed as being achieved. Data Source: PPMS, district agriculture statistics Baseline value: D34 million per ha
